title: "wrapped fixture: a margin figure after a captioned image with no id"
filters:
  - wrapped
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
---

In Typst, Quarto writes a captioned image with no id as a body `#figure(`
call and a float with `.column-margin` as a `#notefigure(` call. The test
summary gives each call its own line, so the image does not take the margin
figure's label.
